capabilities: Insert column layouts with %% cols %% comment markers
Build layouts with fenced code blocks
Edit columns in Live Preview while neighbors stay rendered
Resize columns by dragging dividers or setting percentage and fractional widths
Nest columns and stacks inside each other
extras: README notes the plugin makes no network requests or telemetry and runs on desktop and mobile; it can be installed via BRAT (grafanaKibana/obsidian-colsdown) or by copying release files manually.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to arrange Markdown content side by side in responsive columns or vertical stacks.
summary: Markdown layout plugin that renders responsive column and stack layouts in notes using comment markers or fenced code blocks.
